notes: Added passwordless Supabase email sign-in for MusicVerse personal-library sync.
Yellowdawg now syncs playlists, playlist items, Crazy Covers favorites, Spotify listening history, MusicVerse-open history, daily featured-album history, and saved Tabs & Chords references.
The first sign-in merges existing browser data with remote data instead of replacing either side; browser storage remains the local cache and offline recovery layer.
Added permanent-user restrictive RLS policies so anonymous Yellowdawg sessions cannot access MusicVerse personal tables.
Tabs & Chords now stores real saved references with provider, instrument, tuning, capo, difficulty, notes, and URL metadata.
Library now displays real personal content and account/sync status instead of placeholder copy.
Crazy Covers personal state uses permanent crazy-cover-#### identities while preserving legacy recording UUID compatibility during migration.
